name: PPL Nav — Motorsegler SGS 2-33, EDNY Dreieck

land.touchdown_cas_note: SGS 2-33 motor-glider: no spoilers + motor idles at 0.45 min-throttle -> flies final near cruise, touches engine-off at ~1.8*Vs (still below its 17 m/s cruise). The 1.5*Vs default is textbook for spoiler-equipped aircraft.
